indicator_description: Net balance of trade in goods and services, income, and current transfers measured in current US dollars.
Net transactions of goods, services, income, and current transfers relative to GDP.

indicator_name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (BoP, current US$)
indicator_description: Net inflows of foreign direct investment into the reporting economy.

indicator_name: External debt stocks, total (DOD, current US$)
indicator_description: Total outstanding external debt owed by a country to nonresidents, measured in current US dollars.
Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of acquiring a basket of goods and services.
Lending interest rate adjusted for inflation as measured by the GDP deflator, reflecting the real cost of borrowing.
General government total expenditure expressed as a percentage of GDP, representing the size of the public sector in the economy.

indicator_name: Exports of goods and services (current US$)
indicator_description: Value of all goods and services provided to the rest of the world.

indicator_name: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)
indicator_description: Value of exports of goods and services expressed as a percentage of GDP, indicating the degree of export orientation of the economy.

indicator_name: Imports of goods and services (current US$)
indicator_description: Value of all goods and services received from the rest of the world.

indicator_name: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP)
indicator_description: Value of imports of goods and services expressed as a percentage of GDP, reflecting the economy’s reliance on foreign goods and services.
Sum of exports and imports of goods and services measured as a share of GDP.
Total value of goods and services produced within a country in a given year.
Gross domestic product divided by midyear population; reflecting average income level.

indicator_name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
indicator_description: Share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
Total population based on the de facto definition of population.
